$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (sub-shape of governance-action Content entry's metadata_json). Category A per p2p-design-gate.
title: GovernanceActionMetadata
description: Structured payload inside Content.metadata_json for governance-action entries. Declares threshold, eligibility predicate, ballot format, and deadline. Immutable after publish; child attestation Content entries (votes) reference this entry's CID.

governance_kind.description: Mirrors content_type subtype, denormalized for query (e.g. 'governance-action:renewal-request')

subject_cid.description: CID of the agent / content / device this governance action concerns

threshold.description: Quorum requirement — either m-of-n vote count or percentage of eligible voters

eligibility_predicate.description: Optional eligibility check evaluated against each voting issuer at child commit time. When null, all agents are eligible.

ballot_format.description: Determines how child votes are tallied

closes_at.description: Child attestations committed after this timestamp are rejected by the validator

parameters_json.description: Governance-kind-specific parameters (e.g., the candidate slate for an election)
